name: zclass_world_set_max_dec_features
description: zClass_World::gwWorldSetMaxDecFeatures stores the maximum DEC feature count for world partitioning, capping values above 255 after reporting an old warning.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass with the partition and grid setup helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450f20 validates world-data access through node->classData, the maxFeatures > 255 old error path, cap to 255, byte storage into partitionMaxDecFeatureCount, return 0, and the zError::ReportOldNoOp dependency.
The native smoke verifies normal storage, overflow cap to 255, and low-byte behavior for a negative argument.
